scope: Stable, source-exact excerpts from each writer’s own locally captured poems. All candidate excerpts screened; featured and flagged selections context-reviewed. A fluent-language editorial pass remains recommended before publication. No translation, rewriting or random rotation.

selections.author: Arundhati Mohanty/ ଡ. ଅରୁନ୍ଧତୀ ମହାନ୍ତି
selections.title: ତୁମେ ଏକା ଜଣେ
selections.quote:
ସୀମା ଅଛି ବୋଲି ସିନା
ମୋ ପାଇଁ ସୂର୍ଯ୍ୟର ଆଲୁଅ ସୀମିତ,
context: ଏବେ ତ ମୁଁ ଖୁବ୍ ବେଶୀ ନିରାପଦ
selections.rationale: Selected for a coherent poetic image or central turn; wording preserved verbatim.

selections.author: Manorama Choudhury / ମନୋରମା ଚୌଧୁରୀ
selections.title: ନିବିଡ ହୃଦୟ ନୀଡ
selections.quote:
ଅଟ୍ଟାଳିକା ହୁଏ ଯେତେ ଉଚ୍ଚତର
ସେଡିକି ଗଭୀର ତା ଭିତ୍ତିପ୍ରସ୍ତର
context: ନିଏ ଯେ ଆହୁତି ହୁଏ ଖିନ୍ନ ଭିନ୍ନ
ଯଦି ରଖେ ଅନ୍ୟ ମନ ଆଉ ମାନ
ଛିଡା ଯେ ମନୁଷ୍ୟ ରହେ ଦମ୍ଭ ଧରି

selections.author: Dilip Mohapatra
selections.title: सुषुप्ति
selections.quote:
ख़ून से लहुलुहान तेरी धरती
किस की हैं ये ग़लतियाँ?

selections.author: Bina Singh
selections.title: Keshav, I am Lost
selections.quote:
Why have You disowned me?
Am I not worthy of Your love?
context: Am I not worthy of Your love?
Splinters of wood, caught my eyes
I fail to see the path
Yearn for my Krishna, my Saviour
Pleading rescue, from the haunting darkness
My heart craves for Your Bliss
Huge impediments, stand between You and me
Like the great wall of China
Floating in the sea of uncertainty
I still cling to my unbeaten faith
Holding It amid the absolute darkness
My dauntless faith, continues to pray
That, Your Light will ultimately conquer

selections.author: Soubhagyabanta Moharana/ସୌଭାଗ୍ୟବନ୍ତ ମହାରଣା
selections.title: RAINS : RAPTURES AND RAVAGES
selections.quote:
Rains come as boons of ambrosia
To create heart-throbs
In the decaying and dying earth.
context: Rains come as boons of ambrosia
In the decaying and dying earth.

selections.author: Sujata Parashar
selections.title: Two Poems
selections.quote:
She’s a scrambler
knows how to quickly
make the most of everything
even if it’s just an egg.
context: My mom is an expert in egging the egg
with a pinch of salt and pepper
a dollop of butter and some fresh herbs.
even if it’s just an egg.

selections.author: Prahallad Satapathy/ଡ଼.ପ୍ରହଲ୍ଲାଦ ଶତପଥୀ
selections.title: BE THE POEM
selections.quote:
Beehives and ants creates poetry
Not the gigantic trees,skyscraper buildings
Poetry is always with the children of the lesser God .
context: Poetry is always with the children of the lesser God .

selections.author: Tejaswini Patil
selections.title: It rains ... and rains
selections.quote:
Tapping on the inner plane of silence.
I try to pin every drop
With tiny words.
context: Tapping on the inner plane of silence.
I try to pin every drop
And rehabilitates in the previous incarnation.

selections.author: Debajani Ray/ଦେବଯାନୀ ରାୟ
selections.title: ନିଷ୍ପତି
selections.quote: ହଁ; ..ବର୍ତ୍ତମାନ କବିତା ବେଲଗାମ୍ ହୁସ୍ନ ୱା ଲା ଙ୍କ ମେହେଫିଲ ରେ ।
context: ହଁ; ..ବର୍ତ୍ତମାନ କବିତା ବେଲଗାମ୍ ହୁସ୍ନ ୱା ଲା ଙ୍କ ମେହେଫିଲ ରେ ।

selections.author: Phani Mohanty/ଫନୀ ମହାନ୍ତି
selections.title: ନିରୁତ୍ତର
selections.quote:
ଅଭିସାରିକାର ବେଶଭୂଷା ତମକୁ ଶୋଭା ପାଏନି
ଶୋଭା ପାଏନି ...ମୋନା...

selections.author: Shuvashri Subhasmita Mishra/ଶୁଭଶ୍ରୀ ଶୁଭସ୍ମିତା ମିଶ୍ର
selections.title: ବଲାଙ୍ଗୀର: ଓ ବସନ୍ତିଆ ଖରା
selections.quote:
ବସନ୍ତିଆ ଖରାର ଲାଲ୍ ଆଖି ଦେଖି ଫେରି ଆସିଛି
ମୋ ସହର କୋଳକୁ,
ମୋ ସହରର ବି ଖରା କମ୍ ନୁହେଁ ମ!
context: ବସନ୍ତିଆ ଖରାର ଲାଲ୍ ଆଖି ଦେଖି ଫେରି ଆସିଛି
ମୋ ସହରର ବି ଖରା କମ୍ ନୁହେଁ ମ!

selections.author: Bhaswati Basu/ଭାସ୍ୱତୀ ବସୁ
selections.title: କିଛି ଅମାନିଆ ପୁଅଙ୍କ ପାଇଁ
selections.quote:
ମୁଁ ତତେ ଶିଖେଇ ଦେବି
ହୃଦୟ ଜିଣିବାର କଳା
ଶିଖେଇଦେବି ମତେ ଭଲ ପାଇବାକୁ।

selections.author: Madhuri Panda/ମାଧୁରୀ ପଣ୍ଡା
selections.title: ବିରହ ଭୋଗ
selections.quote:
ଆମ କାହାଣୀର ଶେଷ ଦୃଶ୍ୟ ଏବେ
ନୀରବରୁ ନୀରବ
କେବଳ ମୁଁ ଚାଲୁଥାଏ
ସେ ଆଲୋକିତ ଅନ୍ଧାରରେ..

selections.author: Sharmistha Sahoo/ଶର୍ମିଷ୍ଠା ସାହୁ
selections.title: ମାଆ ଚୁପ୍ ହୋଇଯିବା ମାନେ
selections.quote:
ଏମିତି ଚୁପ୍ ହୋଇଗଲା ଯେ
ତାର ଅନୁପସ୍ଥିତିରୁ ବି ଆଉ
ବାହାରିଲା ନାହିଁ କୌଣସି ଶବ୍ଦ।
context: ତୁ ଚୁପ୍ ରହ, ତୁ ଚୁପ୍ ରହ ତ!

selections.author: Diptirekha Das
selections.title: Don`t Set The Rules For Her
selections.quote:
Don`t set the rules for me
I`m afraid I can`t give you my word
To follow them blindly.
context: Don`t set the rules for me
I`m afraid I can`t give you my word

selections.author: Jayantika/ଜୟନ୍ତିକା
selections.title: ନିରକ୍ଷରା
selections.quote:
ଯେଉଁ କ୍ଷୀଣତମ ଶବ୍ଦଟି
ଆନମନା କରିଦିଏ ବାରମ୍ବାର
ସେଇଟା ତମ ହୃଦୟର ନା ମୋର ?

selections.author: Sweta Rout/ଶ୍ଵେତା ରାଉତ
selections.title: ଜୀବନ ତ ଏମିତି
selections.quote:
ଜୀବନ ପାଦ ଥାପେ ବିଶ୍ଵାସର ପାହାଚରେ
ସମୟ ସାଇତି ଦିଏ  ସ୍ମୃତିଟିଏ
ବିଭୋର ବେଳାର ।
context: ଯେମିତି ଅନ୍ଧାରର ବୁକୁ ଚିରି ଉଇଁଆସେ ସୂର୍ଯ୍ୟ
ଅସୁମାରି ଉତ୍କଣ୍ଡା ନେଇ ଫେରି ଆସିବ ସମୟ
ଜୀବନ ସହିତ ସନ୍ଧି କରି ଜିଇଁବାକୁ ହୁଏ

selections.author: Gopal Lahiri
selections.title: Walkway
selections.quote:
The flowers
pour their honey
on the walkways

selections.author: Sujata Dash
selections.title: Offbeat
selections.quote:
A mulish life I lead
Unlike most homosapiens
Don`t conform to laid down norms
Nor any kind of rule or regulation
context: Don`t conform to laid down norms
Nor any kind of rule or regulation

selections.author: Pravakar Satapathy/ ପ୍ରଭାକର ଶତପଥୀ
selections.title: ମୋ କବିତା
selections.quote:
ବିଶ୍ଵବ୍ରହ୍ମାଂଡ ନୁହେଁ
କି
ସହସ୍ରସୂର୍ଯର ତେଜ ନୁହେଁ
ମୋ କବିତା।

selections.author: Nandita Samanta
selections.title: I WALK WITHIN ME
selections.quote: Light years halt in mere instances, and the moments float as light as dandelions.
context: Light years halt in mere instances, and the moments float as light as dandelions.
Linear time is a triumph of the mind that survives in millions of goodbyes,
mirroring broken smiles that pray for an exit, but…
They come back in afterthoughts to nurture bygone time.

selections.author: Rajorshi Patranabis
selections.title: Crippling assortment
selections.quote:
Lucid words cloud
Prisms of versed contradiction
Wobbled into poetic impotence

selections.author: Manjula Asthana Mahanti
selections.title: ये कहाँ आ गए हम.....
selections.quote:
न जाने किस दौर से गुज़र रहा है जहाँ
देखो जिस तरफ़ भी, बिखराव यहाँ वहाँ।
context: न जाने किस दौर से गुज़र रहा है जहाँ
देखो जिस तरफ़ भी, बिखराव यहाँ वहाँ।

selections.author: Sharmila Ray
selections.title: Different Cities
selections.quote:
There are other kind of cities too-
where midnight crosses sand dunes
to reflect black shadows on walls.
context: There are other kind of cities too-
to reflect black shadows on walls.
Cities where solitude patrols on horse- back.

selections.author: Bhaskaranand Jha Bhaskar
selections.title: Life is a Garden of Roses and Thorns
selections.quote:
Life is not a bed of roses; let them so say
Love winnows all the thorns from our stay.
context: Life is not a bed of roses; let them so say
Love winnows all the thorns from our stay.

selections.author: Sunita Paul
selections.title: MAKE-UP
selections.quote:
It`s better to wear make-up as a mask
Because showing your real face is a difficult task
context: Glossy foundation blended with a fine touch
The compact should not be too much
While applying highlighter you should know when to pause
Each step and stroke tone on tone
With arched eyebrows and the coloured eyelids
A touch of a mascara is all you need
The Kohl laden eyes set on fire
The perfect winged eyeliner stroke is all you desire
Don`t forget to tint your lips
A spray of perfume is the last tip
Is not at all easy, but is real tough
But then the ageing lines and crows-feet near the eyes
It`s better to wear make-up as a mask
Because showing your real face is a difficult task
In a society where hypocrisy is the new trend
Make-up comes as a true friend
People pat your back and will say age with grace
But it`s again they, who will beauty shame and create mess
So philosophically be proud of your flaws and scars
Lastly wear your make-up and shine as a star
selections.rationale: Selected for a coherent poetic image or central turn; wording preserved verbatim.

selections.author: Sujit Kumar Satapathy/ସୁଜିତ କୁମାର ଶତପଥି
selections.title: ଇଚ୍ଛାନଦୀ
selections.quote:
ସେ କିନ୍ତୁ ବହିବ ନିରନ୍ତର
ପ୍ରେମରୁ,
ଘୃଣାରୁ
ଶୂନ୍ଯପଣରୁ...

selections.author: Jyoti Jha
selections.title: Hues of Nature
selections.quote:
I discern the solitude of life
My senses mingle in the vibrance
context: Underneath the pristine blue of sky,
Amidst the luscious green of foliage,
Along the sovereign gleam of sun,
Where nature abounds in the richness of colour
And the grey shadow dwells in diffuse rays
To sing the song of buoyant breeze
Of golden rays above the darkness
Within the quiet and calm of the exuberance
I discern the solitude of life
My senses mingle in the vibrance
And the soul sparkles with purpose

selections.author: Amita Roy
selections.title: PARALLEL THOUGHTS
selections.quote: I shelter my words in sundown script
context: Boney M seduces in flashes sepia
I tap my feet keeping time with time,
The rhythm switches to a fast number
Galloping with world outside the glass door
Inside here it is cold and soporific
Clink of exit and entrance register
"He should be here by now" I tell myself--
The wait tells on my spine
I shelter my words in sundown script
selections.rationale: Selected for a coherent poetic image or central turn; wording preserved verbatim.

selections.author: Jernail Singh Anand
selections.title: TRUTH: PARTIAL AND IMPARTIAL
selections.quote:
History is the warbling noise
Of the river of life
In its glorious as well as meanest flow
Poetry interprets and modifies the show.
context: Our silence can make stones speak,
In its glorious as well as meanest flow
Poetry interprets and modifies the show.

selections.author: Bhagaban Jayasingh
selections.title: GRANDMOTHER
selections.quote:
Soon after his departure
Grandma crushed her glass bangles
on a piece of stone
Then, she dropped back into a deep silence.
context: Then, she dropped back into a deep silence.

selections.author: Elanaaga
selections.title: Quagmire of Confusion
context: in the net flung by paranoia;
bogs down in the slush of ire;
no sudden a happening this either.

selections.author: Debarati Sen
selections.title: Maple Dreams
selections.quote:
I will try to sleep again.
For my dreams are a safer place.
context: Today I woke up to a pastel hued morning.
Had a platter of maple dreams for breakfast!
The sunrays stealing its way through the vertical louvres of the window blinds
The sequins off my dress scattered on the floor
reminded me of our clandestine tryst last night.
The mosaic verses and the innocuous times.
The sudden crescendo of happy hysteria amidst our prosaic lives.
That made me compose haptics poesy
that I could prod on a sombre noon.
The roaring gush of wind shook me up from my ictus.
The concerto of the drizzle broke my slumber and plunged me into the abyss of reality.
My body heavy like the tectonic plates
The rhetoric of grief gradually gnawed at my maple dreams.
I will try to sleep again.
For my dreams are a safer place.

selections.author: Nandini Sahu
selections.title: Manthan—A Ghazal
selections.quote:
Nandini`s conjecture--love churned me, this love was my `manthan`.
Love took me out of the darkness of coalfields, like a granite.
context: Nandini`s conjecture--love churned me, this love was my `manthan`.
Love took me out of the darkness of coalfields, like a granite.

selections.author: Parashuram Rao Gande
selections.title: Naubath Pahad,the hillock
selections.quote:
One should climb the historical hill
With tremendous joy and a strong will
context: One should climb the historical hill
With tremendous joy and a strong will
One should visit the Lord Balaji
Lord Balaji blesses who visit Him
And fills many a heart with bliss to the Brim with unlimited joy
One can view many a beautiful
Sight from the top of the hillock
One can can see the beauty of the Hussain Sagar lake below
In which Lord Buddha stands aloft
In the middle of the pretty lake
Blessing the travellers in the buses
One can see the mighty statue of
Who is one of constitution makers
One can see the great` Smruti chihanam`
In a homage to immortal heroes
The amarajyothi burns day and night
One can see the marvellous newly
Looks like a palace in white
One can see the Ravindra Bharati Auditorium
One can see many more monuments
And Hyderabad of modern days for sure.
selections.rationale: Selected for a coherent poetic image or central turn; wording preserved verbatim.

selections.author: Nurul Hoque
selections.title: Life Need Compassion
selections.quote:
Let all of us come to crave the dream
Life needs compassion as sun beam.
context: Let all of us come to crave the dream
Life needs compassion as sun beam.

selections.author: Swapna Behera
selections.title: THE OMINOUS AGENDA OF A NIGHT
selections.quote:
the virgin eyes will be red soon
who can compose love?
context: sterile faces of the smoky city
passions prisoned in the cage of the skeleton
heads are peeled off like hot potatoes
the sizzling body of the platform
cools down like the last locomotive
whole day a city dies  in the oxymoron
to be alive the next day
sweating of  the pedestrians here or there
the naked mad woman sleeps under railway bridge
artificial smiles pour from the lips of the mannequin
arduous journey of the unknown footsteps
denser are the signatures of the gypsies
each alphabet is a syntax under the sky
the virgin eyes will be red soon
lust is burning in the metropolitan city
the mad woman is pregnant now

selections.author: Bipin Patsani
selections.title: GROWING BIG AND BEAUTIFUL
selections.quote:
The wealth of worth is aesthetic order,
intellectual health and spiritual growth
cemented with love, compassion and care.
context: The wealth of worth is aesthetic order,
cemented with love, compassion and care.

selections.author: Paramita Mukherjee Mullick
selections.title: The lovelorn crane
selections.quote:
In the night, the silence is tuned to a different
mode, it feels strange echo by echo.
context: In the night, the silence is tuned to a different
mode, it feels strange echo by echo.

selections.author: Harinder Cheema
selections.title: At The Time Of Homecoming
selections.quote:
Happily you will go home after all the playing and running
If your Uniform is Stain- free at the   time of Homecoming.
context: God sends us to this world as a mother sends her children to school
On entering this world we mischievously start flouting the rules
Not heeding the warnings we start playing with fire
Our bodies become storehouses of insatiable desire
We start playing foul in the World` s playground
We listen to the noises around by silencing the inner sound
We proudly disrespect all the rules of the school
No wonder a mortal  enters  this world  as a  " Wise Ignorant" but goes back as a " "knowledgeable fool"
Don`t forget that every mother back  at home lovingly waits for her child
The Creator too waits for the souls with a sense of pride
Happily you will go home after all the playing and running
If your Uniform is Stain- free at the   time of Homecoming.

selections.author: Purabi Das
selections.title: The lie
selections.quote:
A lie has a life of its own
It slides out like a slip of larvae
context: A lie has a life of its own
It slides out like a slip of larvae
A beast that often swallows its maker
The lie may be born as an insignificant accident
From a ripple to a Tsunami
A lie follows no set path
And often loses its way in a forest of thorny byways
The whisper of a lie assumes a destructive identity

selections.author: Debajani Tripathy/ଦେବଯାନୀ ତ୍ରିପାଠୀ
selections.title: ଗୋଟେ ପାଗେଳିର ପ୍ରେମ କବିତା
selections.quote:
କାଲି କେହି ଜଦି ଏ କବିତା ପଢେ
କହିବ ପାରେ, `ଏ ତ ଗୋଟେ ପଗେଳିର ପ୍ରେମ କବିତା`
context: ଏକଡ ସେକଡ ହେଇ ଆଖିରେ ଆଖିରେ ରାତି ପାହେ
ଏମିତି କାହିଁକି ହୁଏକେହିଜଣେ ଥାଇ ବି ନଥାଏ
ସେ କିନ୍ତୁ ଥାଏ ସେଇ ଆଖ ପାଖରେ ମୋ ପ୍ରତି ନିଃଶ୍ଵାସରେ ବହୁଥାଏ
ଏମିତି କାହିଁକି ହୁଏ ସେତେବେଳେ ଅତି ଧିମା ସ୍ଵରରେ
କିନ୍ତୁ ବୁଝିପାରୁନା କି ମୁହଁ ଖୋଲି କହିପାରୁନା
ଆଃ ସେଇ ଯନ୍ତ୍ରଣା ଇ ତୋତେ ରାତିସାରା ଶୁଏଇ ଦିଏନି
ଚମକି ଅଧା ନିଦାରୁ ଉଠି ତାକୁଇ ଖୋଜୁ
କହତ ଏ ପ୍ରେମ ନୁହେଁତ କଣ ଆଉ ହେଇପାରେ!

ହଁ ସେଇ ତ ମୋର ଏକମାତ୍ର ମୋର

selections.author: Nilim Kumar
selections.title: AFRUZA SENT ME SOME DATES
selections.quote:
Month of Ramadan
Afruza sent some dates for me
In a packet marked brotherhood.
context: Afruza sent some dates for me
Afruza sent me some dates from Mecca.
Taking the black dates in my hands
No thought of Allah or God crossed my mind
The picture of the date plants
Is flashing on my mental screen
The picture of the date plants
Standing bathed in the misty moonlight
Is flashing on my mental screen
Those that do not call out for Allah and God
They call out for human beings
Who even after having a Mosque
Had built a temple in her bosom.
Afruza sent some dates for me

selections.author: Adyasha Priyadarshini
selections.title: EMBRACING WINTER
selections.quote:
I stare about,
Through my rimy window,
Asking the balmy earth its whereabouts,
Really foggy it does become when my mouth, I blow.
context: Who had a good slumber for like a year,
A cold rosiness passes down my cheek,
To my lip making them dry,
As I watch birds in the open air fly,
I hear the jammed snowy doors creak.
Asking the balmy earth its whereabouts,
Really foggy it does become when my mouth, I blow.
Doing nothing but just pitying me,
`Why do I always have to work?
Natheless winter fills my face with glee.

As the blessing of the sky
In different hues, steeping you in the same light

selections.author: Jayanta Mohapatra/ଜୟନ୍ତ ମହାପାତ୍ର
selections.title: Playing the Magician
selections.quote:
Looks as if with all its silvery light,
the world cannot touch me
with its last sentence, bold, sinless.
context: Sunday, Rest day of the Week
when I turn the pages of the morning Newspaper
and bury the simple sadness of autumn
in the spilt blood of another child`s murder,
Somehow I do not think it`s a Story at all,
In the distance comes the dying echo
of a moving train, and you are suddenly someone
old and distant, a goat hanging in a butcher`s shop,
seeing more than you`ve seen before in your life.
The leaves susurrate in the bamboo stems
to make me sense that there was something
may be behind it that was quite important,
A persistence of my own mortality perhaps.
Or the oneness between me and the world.
Grass had closed its eyes as it watched
A Prime Minister pick up the body of India
Which he felt lay battered inside his chest.
Sunday when I thought I was accountable to myself,
Was I dying within myself for the sorrows -
I suffered for the world that wasn`t with me enough?
Sometimes the coils of ropes of a country`s conscience
Straighten themselves and rise up into the air.
Into God`s hand, hanging there unseen to help, Sometimes
Someone asks himself, before he falls asleep,
Whether he was happy to live in the land that was India.
A handful of space from the size
Of a cathedral. Although no wind is there still,
The boat tied offshore has moved a little,
And tied with it the apprehension of another self.
But the world is there, beginning to speak again,
And I`ve lost the ability to disappear.
Looks as if with all its silvery light,
with its last sentence, bold, sinless.
Which part of one is it that has to be put away?
The logic of winning, or the magic of living
backwards in time? I can`t resist the urge
that takes hold of me for some unspoken chaos,
or the pain of collecting mushrooms in the wet woods,
that never fail to remind us of who we think we are.

The birds in the front eaves,
The still water in the pond
The dews a-tremble on the frond!
All remind me of those bygone days

selections.quote:

This life, the moments that I spend
In the warmth of hearth and heart?
context: This life, the moments that I spend
In the warmth of hearth and heart?

Who says its all up in the air?
I could taste it in the biryani

I could feel in the many colours
That you loved watching me drape
Pink and yellow were the favorites
And then the perfumes, especially that one
While I waited for you at airport lounge at Amsterdam
A few euros though it had a strange smoky europeaness
Even I could bet no one can resist hugging the smell

selections.quote:

Raindrops on the lines of our palms
Sunrise on the skylines so high

Comfort myself with three letter word
I am born different.

selections.title: The Pain

selections.author: Antaryami Mishra
selections.title: The Road Taken
selections.quote: The friendless road taken: my only identity, means and me.
context: Between the zealous day of my first walk
And unwillingness to step out any more today.
Countless new roads snaking through directions different then,
Convincingly teach me today: Vein-like ways
Melt in one another; directions: upon my face-ward turns.
These days, the road I set my foot on
Finds a co-operative but competitive companion
Whom I know fairly well, since long:
Reticent, relentless, absent minded, brooding all along.
Chasing like shadow, tight-lipped, hardly sharing inner feelings
The poet in me is not mine, his concerns cover
Entire world, a supporting silhouette, following him am I
The friendless road taken: my only identity, means and me.

Will you come again to make me rejunavated?
Will you come again to make me passionated?
Will your seduction once again make me sedated?
Will your kisses once again make me feel animated?
Will your touch once again make me feel wanted?

selections.title: Caretaker

My caretaker in life
Will you not be so in death?
context: I know I can only tell you
Will you not be so in death?
The caretaker of this house of my life
Under the mantel-piece where we spent passionate moments
Lies the key to everything that was my life
Do what you want with it
My last gift in this hour of reckoning.

selections.author: Prabashini Mahakuda
selections.title: In This Body
selections.quote:
This body bends down , the warmth of the body lessens
The different stories of life
She has seen life in delicate dreams
context: On this day the burden of fifty-eight years
Of boons , blood , flesh , the marrow and hair , tears
This body bends down , the warmth of the body lessens
She has seen life in delicate dreams
The half seen dream has ruined suddenly in mid night
Some dreams fall like tears on a pillow
The reality`s some coloured , some black and white drawings
What does the body do when burden on body increases
She tells the morning light to lessen the burden
She did not sleep last night
She was suffocated due to asthma and cold
She pleads to the Lord to keep the day calm and gentle
For the last eight months she has been enduring
The private grief of loss that burns down everything
If nothing else , offer her an adversary
Who would be equal to her ,just like her
And he should be always ready
to carry her burden far above life

selections.author: Sonali Pattnaik
selections.title: the unknowable
selections.quote:
you need not discard
all that you cannot believe
context: a god who is nine kinds of creatures
imagination of a crazed poet in love
it comes from the same part of vastness,
although an achingly long time ago,
I learn, as I have done. born from the ink
of a poet`s love of paradox,
or perhaps the story`s wide open mouth,
who lives in the mind-tongues of artists`
hands as they twist and cross
fine fingers and legs and become flowers
upon the still water of creation
as they bring to bear upon a patachitra
a kaleidoscopic dancer in the wild,
a kind of god, a kind of myth, a spectral thing,
neither human nor animal, nor both,
or that whom only this stupendous earth
you have come to me today as a vision
in the dark, as though you wish
to whisper to me some ancient secret.
I lower my ear and heart
put down your bow, you say,
all seeds to the ground fall
or own the world in knowledge
you need not know me, nor I you
and yet to each other`s truth
in many lies the form of one
let the cloud of ego melt
you too have a rooster`s plume
a tiger`s claw and the stinging
and mighty snake as a tail
that follows you and raises its hood
or none of these you are at all
who knows the self or the other, ever?
don`t train the arrow at that
making a god in your human form
don`t train the arrow of subjugation
at all that you don`t know­–

selections.quote:

And I listen to the unsaid words they try to speak
context: As if they decipher the silence in my numb eyes
And I listen to the unsaid words they try to speak
They stand with their mute glances
A melody that reaches to my ears only
The melody that they whisper to themselves
Streaming and ringing in the leaves
I can fathom why the greens are so soothing
They compose a rhythm that they sing
The sky and the air resonate them
For the mechanical world they are dumb and mute
Not all have the eyes to see beyond the sight
We live in a world full of possessions
Where humans can`t even listen to the voice of their own soul
The emptiness that dwells in my soul finds solace
When the green leaves sway with the sweet breeze
Planting a beautiful smile all over me

selections.author: Pankhuri Sinha
selections.title: Serdica Metro Station
context: Walking amidst the remains of Serdica
An age passes by quietly, almost
Till absolute order descends over extreme chaos
Time freezes or not hard to say
Spinning and weaving threads of peace
And just as the cuckoon, readies to rest ;
Mars joins too! Time is not;
A fresco but a melting pot
Not even Cleopatra can;diffuse the stand off!;
But once begun, the war is a brutal sport !;
Generals and Colonels, Marshals and Captains;
On horses and on foot, Survey the land;
And the map! Oh! Weapons and weapons;
Escalate the war ! But have you seen;
Paintings depicting the end? Retreating armies;
Agreement, in stones ! Age old writing;
On stone columns, 30 years peace contract;
Dear Athena, Call Apollo ! This world;
Needs healing! Spinning;around! Looking for time!;
There isn`t any! The metro `s here! Before you board;
Sveta Sofia still smiles ! A bird in hand !
Turn around, embrace;the glory and beauty of life!;
The train leaves but come again to Serdica
And post;peace letters to all you can!

context: In it we went with the flow
Reflecting our moments like a mirror.

selections.author: Susmita Patel
selections.title: କାମନାର ବିନାଶ
selections.quote:
ହେ ପୁରୁଷ ଶ୍ରେଷ୍ଠ
ତୁମେ ସବୁ ତ୍ୟାଗିଦେଇ
ହୋଇଯାଇ ପାର ବୁଦ୍ଧ ।

selections.author: Umesh Chandra Mohapatra
selections.title: ଆକାଶର ହସ
selections.quote:
ଚୁପ୍‌କିନା ଫୁଟୁଥିବା ଫୁଲକୁ ଦେଖି
ପ୍ରତିଦିନ ହସିଦିଏ ଆକାଶ।

selections.author: Boby Borah
selections.title: The Girl
selections.quote:
Searching a trisul
The girl has been waiting devotedly
In the river side
To become Durga .
context: The girl has been waiting devotedly

selections.author: Renette D Souza
selections.title: You`re Infinite
selections.quote:
You surround me, are all around me
All majestic, exalted and sublime
Diverse in this unending universe
Transcending the portals of time.
context: You surround me, are all around me

selections.author: Chittaranjan Mishra/ ଚିତ୍ତ ରଞ୍ଜନ ମିଶ୍ର
selections.title: ପ୍ରଥମ ଧାଡିରୁ
selections.quote:
ସେମାନଙ୍କୁ ଖୋଜିବାକୁ ପଡେ
ଅତଡ଼ା ଧସିବ ପରବର୍ତୀ ଅନ୍ଧାରରୁ
ଦାହ ଶେଷରେ ଅସ୍ଥି ପରି ପାଉଁଶ ଭିତରୁ I
context: ଦାହ ଶେଷରେ ଅସ୍ଥି ପରି ପାଉଁଶ ଭିତରୁ I

selections.author: Pranati Behera / ପ୍ରଣତି ବେହେରା
selections.title: ମଧୁମୟ
selections.quote:
ରାତି
ଶୁଣଉଥାଉ
ପୃଥିବୀର ଗର୍ଭଗୃହରୁ ଧିମ୍ ଧିମ୍ ପାଦଶବ୍ଦ
ଦିଅ  ତାକୁ ନିରୁତା ଅଂଧାର ।

selections.author: Asish Kumar Mishra/ ଆଶିଷ କୁମାର ମିଶ୍ର
selections.title: ଦୁଃଖ
selections.quote:
ଜାଣିଜାଣି ତମେ ମତେ
ଦେଉଥିବ ଦୁଃଖ
ସରିଯିବି ସରିଯିବି
ଦୁଃଖ ଗଲେ ସରି !

selections.author: Sumati Mund / ସୁମତି ମୁଣ୍ଡ
selections.title: ଅପେକ୍ଷା କରିବି କିପରି
selections.quote:
ଯାବତୀୟ ଦୁଃଖକୁ ତଥାସ୍ତୁ କହି
ମଲା ସ୍ବପ୍ନର ମାଟି ନେଇ ତୁମେ
ଗଢିପାର ନିଜ ମନ ମୁତାବକ
ଜମା ଶବ୍ଦ ତୋଳୁନଥିବା ଈଶ୍ବରୀଟେ ।

selections.author: Nandini Mitra
selections.title: I`M FALLING APART
selections.quote:
Hazy and misty,
Today is what I have,
To love, believe and live.
context: Yet I embrace all that`s gone,
It`s as far as I can see,

selections.author: Ramakrushna/ ରାମକୃଷ୍ଣ
selections.title: ଆୟୁଷ
selections.quote:
ସତେ କଣ ମୋର ବଂଚିବାର ଥିଲା
ଆୟୂଷ ବାହାରେ ଅନ୍ୟ ଏକ
ଅଜଣା ଆୟୂଷ !

selections.author: Trinath Singh/ ତ୍ରିନାଥ ସିଂ
selections.title: ଲୁହବୁନ୍ଦେ
selections.quote:
ଦୂର ଦୂର ଯାଏଁ କିଛି ବି କୋଉଠି ନାହିଁ ଏତେବଡ଼ ଆକାଶରେ...
ବର୍ଷିଯାନ୍ତା ହେଲେ ଏତେବେଳେ ବର୍ଷା ଅସରାଏ !!
context: ଦୂର ଦୂର ଯାଏଁ କିଛି ବି କୋଉଠି ନାହିଁ ଏତେବଡ଼ ଆକାଶରେ...

selections.author: Eva Petropoulou-Lianou
selections.title: Fallen Angel
selections.quote:
Put back your beautiful wings
This world needs you to heal!!!!
context: This world needs you to heal!!!!

selections.author: Prasanna Kumar Swain / ପ୍ରସନ୍ନ କୁମାର ସ୍ଵାଇଁ
selections.title: ପ୍ରଶ୍ନଘେରରେ ପ୍ରସନ୍ନ
selections.quote:
କୋଉଟା ଜୀବନ ପାଇଁ ଭାରି ଦରକାର
ଚୋରା ଚାଇତାଳି ନା ଚାଷ ଜମି ମାଟି ସମତୁଲ?
context: ଚୋରା ଚାଇତାଳି ନା ଚାଷ ଜମି ମାଟି ସମତୁଲ?

selections.author: Laszlo Aranyi
selections.title: Art
selections.quote:
The remains are a cooled off, lifeless cosmic spider web,
what for a moment, the charlatan
enchanted to live.
context: The remains are a cooled off, lifeless cosmic spider web,
what for a moment, the charlatan

selections.author: Rabi Satapathy / ରବି ଶତପଥି
selections.title: କବିତାର କଥା
selections.quote:
ଯେଉଁ ସ୍ୱପ୍ନ ଟିକକ
ସେ ଆଖିରେ ବୋଳିଦେଇ ଯାଏ
ସେ ରାତିରେ ଶବ୍ଦ ସବୁ
ଆଉ ଧରାପଡନ୍ତି ନାହିଁ ହାତରେ।

selections.author: Santasree Choudhury
selections.title: Confession
selections.quote:
An unknown vastness of dignity
Where sparkling stars
greet with open arms...

selections.author: Bibhu Padhi
selections.title: RIVERS
selections.quote:
I know how they have been acting out
some role from an ancient time—
context: I know how they have been acting out
some role from an ancient time—

selections.author: Binaya Kumar Mohanty / ବିନୟ କୁମାର ମହାନ୍ତି
selections.title: ମୁଁ ଶୋଇ ପଡୁଛି
selections.quote:
ମୋ ଚୌହଦୀରେ
ପୂଜରକ୍ତ ସାଲୁବାଲୁ ମୁମୁର୍ଷୁ ପୃଥିବୀ
ଜିଜିବିଷାର କୃମିକୀଟ ପରି
ଦଣ୍ଡେ ଘଡ଼ିଏ ଜୀବନ ମାଗୁଛି।

selections.author: Zakir Khan / ଜାକିର ଖାନ
selections.title: ମଣିଷ
selections.quote:
ତେବେ ବି ମଣିଷ ଏତେ ଅନ୍ଧ ଥିଲା ଯେ
ସେ ଏସବୁକୁ କିଛି ବୁଝି ପାରୁନଥିଲା
ଓ ତ୍ରିଶଙ୍କ ଅବସ୍ଥାକୁ ସଠିକ ଅବସ୍ଥା ମନେ କରି
ଖୁବ ଶାନ୍ତିରେ ଥିଲା...
context: ତେବେ ବି ମଣିଷ ଏତେ ଅନ୍ଧ ଥିଲା ଯେ
ଓ ତ୍ରିଶଙ୍କ ଅବସ୍ଥାକୁ ସଠିକ ଅବସ୍ଥା ମନେ କରି

selections.author: Chaitali Chattopadhyay
selections.title: Afghanistan
selections.quote:
The flowers must be in bloom somewhere,
she thinks-
The birds chirp.
context: She has laid herself by the darkness thinking,
`How far pungent the odour of blood can be!`
The wall has reached her forehead,
her eyes- won`t they be able to catch a glimpse of the sky?
Would they flow and flow forward?
Be engrossed in the sound of blast?
The flowers must be in bloom somewhere,

selections.author: Shankar Parida/ଶଙ୍କର ପରିଡା
selections.title: ଦୀପାବଳି
selections.quote:
ଆପଣ ବି ମୋ ଚଉଦ ପୁରୁଷର
ପୂର୍ବପୁରୁଷ, ମୁଁ ପୂର୍ବାପର ଭଗ୍ନାବଶେଷ
ଉଭୟ ଅବଶେଷ ଓ ଅବସୋସ।
context: ମୁଁ ଅର୍କ୍ଷିତ ଈଶ୍ୱର ଆପଣ ସମ୍ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ମଣିଷ
ଅପଣଙ୍କ ଠୁ ବେଶି ଅପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ଓ ଅଧାଗଢା
ଅଧାଗଢା ହାତ ପାଦ ଆଖି ନାକ କାନ
ଘନ ଘୋର ଅନ୍ଧାରରେ କାଉଁରିଆ କାଠି ଜାଳି
ମୁଁ ଡାକୁଛି ଆସ ଆସ ହେ ପୂର୍ବ ପୁରୁଷ
ଆସ ପ୍ରଭୁ ଲଳିତ ଲବଙ୍ଗ ଦ୍ବୀପ ଶେଷ ମୃତ୍ୟୁ
ଆସ ଆସ ଅନାଗତ ଅବଶିଷ୍ଟ ଉତ୍ତର ପୁରୁଷ
ଗୋଟି ପହଣ୍ଡିରେ ଆସ ରତ୍ନ ସିଂହାସନ ଛାଡି
କାଠର କଣ୍ଢେଇ ହାତ ନାହିଁ ପାଦ ନାହିଁ
ଆଖି ନାହିଁ କାନ ନାହିଁ ବାଜିଗଲେ ଦୋଷ ନାହିଁ
ଦୀପାଳି ଜାଳୁଛି ଆଜି ବାଇଶି ପାହାଚ ତଳେ

selections.author: Himanshu Parida / ହିମାଂଶୁ ପରିଡା
selections.title: My Mother`s Death
selections.quote: Shall stop as the window is not opened.
context: Shall stop as the window is not opened.

selections.author: Jyoti Shankar Panda “Hayat”
selections.title: गीतकवि की व्यथा
selections.quote:
मैं गीत बेचकर घर आया
सुख साधन सारा भर आया
कवि-मन टूटा, शरमाया
ऐ जनता मुझे क्षमा करना !

selections.author: Neelam Saxena Chandra
selections.title: Shores are not always silent
selections.quote:
Your mind is like a silent shore-
Everyone believes that it`s calm.
context: Your mind is like a silent shore-
An onlooker may lazily spend a few hours-
Sitting, sipping tea and even eating pyaaj-pakoras,
An ardent photographer may try to capture
A weekend painter may come with his canvas
And paint the contours of the staid shore,
A notable poet may write on the reflections
Of the night lights that rhythmically shake in water.
That the shore is gracefully calm.
Keep striking towards the poised surface
Again and again and yet again…
And if you don`t dip your meandering mind
In a sacred bottle of nirvanic nectar
And fearlessly face the inner turmoil,
The waves may also erode you,
selections.rationale: Selected for a coherent poetic image or central turn; wording preserved verbatim.

selections.author: Jaydeep Sarangi
selections.title: Road to a Different Person
selections.quote:
By riding the Himalayas, living with sinful stars
I became a different person.
context: By riding the Himalayas, living with sinful stars

selections.author: Malini Mohanty
selections.title: Being A Girl
selections.quote:
Thank You Almighty
For Making Me A Girl
I`d Love to Have Same Life
Even in My Next Birth
context: I`d Love to Have Same Life

selections.author: Sweety Sony Lall
selections.title: LITTLE SPARROWS
selections.quote:
You should have to keep your faith in my unions,
We are not alone!
context: Why you have become so pessimistic about the false visions!
You should have to keep your faith in my unions,
That`s why we have a lot of our potential boons.

selections.author: Kakoli Ghosh
selections.title: The Water Of Life
selections.quote:
Selling leftover care, death earns life,
stray love licks careless dreams,spilt;
late moment runs gasping after time,
stares blank at the empty railway line.
context: Selling leftover care, death earns life,
late moment runs gasping after time,
stares blank at the empty railway line.

selections.author: Tahera Mannan
selections.title: A Moment
selections.quote:
A moment dropped from the basket of time
And went to pay its many debts
context: A moment dropped from the basket of time
And went to pay its many debts
A smile no time to spread
The moment picked those heartstrings up
No music came no love sang
I went to look for the fallen moment
And found an entire saga of Faith
selections.rationale: Selected for a coherent poetic image or central turn; wording preserved verbatim.

selections.author: Raghu Seshabhattar
selections.title: Swing
selections.quote:
I convert the dreams of the past
to a swing again and rock them.
context: After judging the current moment like this,
I bring a strange illusion stored in an astral casket
as if my antique dreams are sprouting!
As if some ancient goddess, discerning the secret lingo,
scooped them and offered me sugar candies.
I convert the dreams of the past
to a swing again and rock them.
the visible crowns are useless carvings.

selections.author: Jinatamam Darji
selections.title: ମାଷ୍ଟର ମାଇଣ୍ଡ
selections.quote:
ଆକାଶ ଓ ମାଟି ପରସ୍ପରଠୁ
ଅଧିକ ଦୂରେଇ ଗଲେଣି ଆଜିକାଲି
ଏ ବ୍ୟବଧାନର କାରଣ
କିଛି ଶୀତଳ ଯୁଦ୍ଧ ନୁହେଁ ତ?

selections.author: Kavita Singh
selections.title: इंतज़ार
selections.quote:
अभी भी वक्त है गलतियों को सुधार लो तुम!
माँ-बाप के पैर छूकर पाप को पुण्य कर लो तुम!
context: अभी भी वक्त है गलतियों को सुधार लो तुम!
माँ-बाप के पैर छूकर पाप को पुण्य कर लो तुम!

selections.author: Til Kumari Sharma
selections.title: Shining Statue of Mine
selections.quote:
Ethical garland of words
Around statue of myself, to the light of earth
Being goddess of universe.
context: Shining as moon and her lone journey
So I make my statue myself
Myself guide and heart of kindness
Giving light to others in darkness
Shining in universe as art of words
Alone I am able to light myself.
Giving priority to my insanity of ideas
Around statue of myself, to the light of earth
Untouched by people, unused by fake
Words make the statue of myself.

selections.author: Sasmita Rout
selections.title: ଈଶ୍ବର
selections.quote: ତେବେ ବି କେତେ ନିଷ୍ଠୁର ଜଣେ ହୋଇପାରେ!
context: ତେବେ ବି କେତେ ନିଷ୍ଠୁର ଜଣେ ହୋଇପାରେ!

selections.author: Divya Vats
selections.title: हर एक सूर्यास्त की सुबह होगी
selections.quote:
हर वो सपने जो टूट के बिखरने लगे हों
तो एक नया ख़्वाब जन्म लेगा
context: हर वो सपने जो टूट के बिखरने लगे हों
तो एक नया ख़्वाब जन्म लेगा
हर एक वो दरवाजा जो बंद हो गया है
हर एक अंत की एक नई शुरूआत होगी
हर बीता हुआ लम्हा, एक नई सौगात होगा
हर एक दौर का एक नया अंजाम होगा
कुछ भी यन्हा ऐसा नहीं, जो विलुप्त हो गया
मिलती रहेगी हर एक चीज़ रुप बदल।।

selections.author: Tamali Neogi
selections.title: Fallen Leaf
selections.quote:
Shadows of Kartikeya, the globe trotter, excitement ultimate,
Ganesha reaches the meaning in calm poise , the Fakir twits.
context: What is heroic in our heroes defeating evil by unfair means,
What is more important, action or contexts defining them?
The scholars argue, the socialists debate,
Aren`t the politicians the wisest beings?
Identities erased; look at the burning effigies
We blissfully forget what even a pigeon and a dove afford not,
Black, white or grey, in this grand show, Death equalizes all.
Here stands up the poet, the lead role in the parliament of ethics,
Ravana`s chariot is Rama`s vehicle, as Garuda of Vishnu,
Enemies are friends if the battles are won.
Arjuna or Karna, the game is lost, find out the holy grail,
Unfair it is that elixir was meant only for Gods.
Shadows of Kartikeya, the globe trotter, excitement ultimate,
Ganesha reaches the meaning in calm poise , the Fakir twits.
Attacked by the alien, the academicians stop a little,
Singing His praise! Let us crush under our feet, the fallen leaf, daring.

selections.author: Eileen Moynihan
selections.title: A Child Again
selections.quote:
Relishing her discovery of words,
I want the joy of being a child again.
context: “We’re having a day off,” she says
She points at birds chasing crumbs.
I want the joy of being a child again.

selections.author: Seema Sharma
selections.title: सर्वे भवन्तु सुखिन
selections.quote:
सोचती ईश्वर सुन रहे हैं मेरे मन की बात
अब संसार सुखमय हो जायेगा
मैं देखूंगी सबको मुस्कुराते ।
context: सोचती ईश्वर सुन रहे हैं मेरे मन की बात

selections.author: Anita Ray
selections.title: ନିଜକୁ ଖୋଜିବାକୁ ପଡ଼େ
selections.quote:
ଗୋଟିଏ ଗୁମୁସୁମ ନୀରବତା
କହିବାକୁ ଗଲେ ସେ ନୀରବତା ହିଁ
ଅତୁଟ ପ୍ରେମ ଆଉ ପୀରତି ର କଥା ...
context: ମୋ ମନ ଆଉ ବିବେକ ର ଭାଷା
ଦିନ ଥିଲା କାହାକୁ କେମିତି ଵାଣ୍ଟି ପାରୁଥିଲି
ଅତୁଟ ପ୍ରେମ ଆଉ ପୀରତି ର କଥା ...

selections.author: Malay Mishra
selections.title: ଭାବିନିଅ ଘୋର ବନସ୍ତରେ
selections.quote:

विचारों की उड़ान देश-विदेश की यात्रा है, संगीत की स्वर में बजती रहे। विचारधारा के बादलों को छिड़कती है, सृजन की आग में जलती रहे।
विचारों की उड़ान विचार के पंख है, हर संदेश को दूर-दूर तक ले जाती है। मन की उत्साह की चमक को बहती है, नई सोच को प्रगाढ़ता से पहचानती है।
विचारों की उड़ान दरिया को पार करे, विपदाओं के तूफ़ानों में भी टिकी रहे। ज्ञान की धारा में बहती रहे, संघर्षों के पहाड़ों को छिद्र बनाती रहे।
विचारों की उड़ान दृष्टि को उच्चाईयों तक ले जाती है, अविचलित मन की स्वतंत्रता बनाती है। विचार की गाथा हर किसी को सुनाती है, विचारों की उड़ान, नए सपनों को सजाती है।

To the elms swaying as if in a dance of farewell.
Night crowds around like a velvet blanket.
Shrouding the bright waters in a black net.
Lingering, to stay with the world in which it revels!!
Infusing a sense of infinite calm.
Voices of Lord`s praise sung in rhymes
Arise from the Earth around, reaching Heaven through this calm!.
Another day has ended with all it`s swords and songs.
Yet for some delight or consolation one longs.
Many a dreams seem to have been buried
In the toil for fulfilling basic need.
Yet, one awaits the rejuvenating dawn
When we can sail the Ocean of Life like a swan.
The dawn that gives priceless hope;
Hope, that Despair will not throttle like a gnarled rope.
That,a soul, in alleys of Lonliness and Tears need not grope!!

selections.title: A Traveller`s Tale
selections.quote:
The world was green, the world is blue,
Time arrived but swiftly flew,
What beyond those mountains lay,
Curious perhaps, I lost my day.
context: The world was green, the world is blue,
Curious perhaps, I lost my day.

selections.author: Mitra Samal
selections.title: Remember Freedom
selections.quote:
To be free is to speak without fear
To live without disguise
To be able to love and be loved
without being questioned or judged
context: To be free is to speak without fear
To be able to love and be loved

selections.author: Prabhanjan K. Mishra
selections.title: LOGO
selections.quote:
Mira collected her memory and folded
them back to her heart to carry them
to her grave that she waited with joy.
context: Mira collected her memory and folded
them back to her heart to carry them
to her grave that she waited with joy.

selections.author: Swagatika Mishra/ ସ୍ବାଗତିକା ମିଶ୍ର

selections.quote:

କୂଟା ଯାଇନି ମୋ ହାତରେ
context: ମାଟିରେ ଗାତ କରି ପୋତି ହେଇଯିବ ନା ଦାଗି ହେବ ଦେହର
ଧଳା ଦାଗ ପିଇ କାଗଜ କାଇଁ ପାଲଟି ଯାଇ ନଥିବ ସାଦା !
ମୁଁ ବିଶ୍ୱାସରେ ମରିଯାଉଛି ବୁଡି ଯିବା ପାଇଁ

selections.author: Bichitra Dash/ ବିଚିତ୍ରା ଦାଶ

selections.quote:
ଜୀବନ ଜୀବନରେ ଏ ଜୀବନ
ଦେ` ରେ ମୋ` ନିଃଶ୍ୱାସରେ ମୁଠେ ନିର୍ମଳ ପବନ ।

selections.author: Abanindra Udgata/ ଅବନୀନ୍ଦ୍ର ଉଦଗାତା
selections.title: ଭୋକର ଅନ୍ୟନାମ
selections.quote:
ଭୋକ ହଉଛି?
ଭୀଷଣ ଭୋକ
ଅସରନ୍ତି ବର୍ଷା ର ହସ
ବିପର୍ଯ୍ୟସ୍ତ ପୃଥିବୀ ର ଆଖି ।

selections.author: Soumya Sephali Sahoo
selections.title: PAPERBOAT
selections.quote:
But the more she tried to
Sail on a luxury cruise,
Fate intervened to show
That hers was a paperboat.

selections.author: Manini Jena / ମାନିନୀ ଜେନା

selections.quote:

context: କବିତା ଏବେ କବାଡ଼ିଆ ଘରେ ରଦ୍ଦି ହେଲାଣି

କବିତା ଲେଖି ବସିଲେ ତା କଣ କବିତା ହେବ ?

selections.author: Sangita Das/ ସଂଗୀତା ଦାସ
selections.title: କବିତା ଲେଖୁଥିବା ଝିଅ
selections.quote:
କବିତାକୁ ଭୋଗେ ସିଏ କବିତାକୁ ଭାବେ
କବିତା ଲେଖୁଥିବା ଝିଅ ଠିକ୍ ତା ପରି ବଞ୍ଚେ।
context: ଧରା ବନ୍ଧା ଜୀବନକୁ ଖୁବ୍ ନିନ୍ଦା କରେ
ଈଶ୍ୱରକୁ ମଣିଷ କେବେ ପୁଣି ମଣିଷକୁ ଈଶ୍ୱର ସେ ଭାବେ
ନିଜ ମନ ଇଲାକାରେ ସିଏ ଆଧିପତ୍ୟ କରେ

selections.author: Mahi Rao/ माही राव
selections.title: विरह
selections.quote:
एक पल में, मेरे मन को शबनम ने और,
साथ ज्योति ने मिलकर छुआ था कभी।
context: महुआ की छांव में, चांदनी के तले,
तुमसे मिलने का वादा हुआ था कभी।
एक पल में, मेरे मन को शबनम ने और,
साथ ज्योति ने मिलकर छुआ था कभी।
बाट में तेरी पलकें बिछाई मगर,
अपनी राहों से काटें हटा न सके।

selections.author: Lopamudra Banerjee
selections.title: Absence
selections.quote:
Old memories masquerade, dream-like.
They write themselves
against the scarred flesh and muscle of Time.
context: against the scarred flesh and muscle of Time.
Was it a tinge of taunting friendship
or a wild rendezvous of a short-lived,
The molten grief of dead ones
who dwindled, by and by, like fallen leaves?
Forgotten lyrics and rhythms of a dying heart
that had once, throbbed with a symphony of fire?
In this dusty landscape now, my hissing prose
my rattling rhyme sings of absence,
the absence of the luminous wings,
the rain of migrant music that welled as tears
the clamor of voices that tangled
In absence, I find the note, the sound, the want
I ingest the melting soul of the missing puzzles
and the music of nothingness bubbles up.
The nothingness that makes the flesh and bones,
the sinew and muscles of my nameless verses.

selections.author: Sabita Singh Meera/ सविता सिंह मीरा
selections.title: मन! आकाशगंगा
selections.quote:
हृदय के भीतर
न जाने कितने ब्रह्मांड बसते हैं।
context: न जाने कितने ब्रह्मांड बसते हैं।
selections.rationale: A complete image of inner life as many universes.

selections.author: Chirashree Indrasingh
selections.title: ମୁଁ ଯେତିକି ଭୋଗୁଛି ତୋ ଭାଗରେ ତା ଠାରୁ କମ୍ ପଡୁ ଖରା
selections.quote:
ଆମ ସାନ ସହରଟିର ନାମ
ବାରମ୍ବାର ଲେଖା ହେଉଚି ଟିଭି ପରଦାରେ
ନାଲି ହରଫରେ।

selections.author: Matralina Pati
selections.title: Bubbles within
selections.quote:
Molten hell seethes within me
Still, it fails
To spill out of
A wrenched heart.

selections.author: Sangeeta Dey ( Roy)
selections.title: Haflong
selections.quote:
Last night it’s shadows waltzed,
To the serenade played exclusively for me.
context: To the serenade played exclusively for me.

selections.author: Randy Brooks
selections.title: Five Haiku
selections.quote:
tadpoles jiggle
remember the day we
found our legs?

selections.author: Reema Sinha
selections.title: That old woman
selections.quote:
The moon showed off its full splendour,
In that light I could perfectly spot her.
context: The moon showed off its full splendour,
In that light I could perfectly spot her.

selections.author: Dilip Rakshit
selections.title: From core to zeal world
selections.quote:
A black veil frequently engulfs us
aeon after aeon, as pods are captive
context: A black veil frequently engulfs us
aeon after aeon, as pods are captive
light always intrudes inside the caliginous
sphere, excellent! so indigenous, so true.

selections.author: Mallika Tripathi
selections.title: Angel
selections.quote:
Emerging victorious,
It perpetually rules the city-of-light,
Leading a spiritual life,
It becomes immortal...
context: An angel resides beyond any anguish,
Striving to create `the Land of the leal`,
It pushes people to be the ultimate conqueror,
It adores all but connects with none.
Being blessed with a peculiar sense of seeing the naked truth,
It possesses the power to control demons.

selections.author: Binapani Debta / ବୀଣାପାଣି ଦେବତା
selections.title: ଜଣେ କବି ନୀରବ ହୋଇଗଲେ
selections.quote:
ଦୁନିଆର ଯେତେକ ନାମ ଜଣା ଅଜଣା ଚଢେଇ
ଭିଡ଼ କଲେ ତାଂକ ହାତରୁ ଆହାର
ଖାଇବାର ପ୍ରତିଯୋଗିତାରେ ।
context: ଦୁନିଆର ଯେତେକ ନାମ ଜଣା ଅଜଣା ଚଢେଇ

selections.author: Aakash Nayak
selections.title: SKELETON
selections.quote:
In the mouth of an ant
Clusters of stars emerge.
context: There is a skeleton of a serpent
in which ants are humming silently.
All are shining in the darkness of the skeleton.
In the mouth of an ant
Ant-hills melt down to its every crack.
In the swirl of sands, under the refuge of the skeleton,
the grains shine by the rays

selections.quote:

selections.title: ବାହାରୁ ଭିତରକୁ
selections.quote:

selections.title: ବ୍ୟର୍ଥ ଦିନ
selections.quote:

selections.author: Sudhakar Gaidhani
selections.title: AGE CAN BE WASHED LIKE A GARMENT
selections.quote:
Age too, after washing like a garment
has to be dried
on the ropes of life
context: Age too, after washing like a garment
But if the age itself is older
must turn into a peacock`s feather,
And the body must be cleansed
like bathing a child lightly with hands,
And weaving with a needle, with love,
the patches need to be stitched again
And, at the final moment of soap,
it needs to be handed over to

selections.author: Chaitali Sengupta
selections.title: 1971, Noakhali
selections.quote:
Killed like mosquitoes. Countless times, she murmurs
the names of every single lost soul.
context: Killed like mosquitoes. Countless times, she murmurs
the names of every single lost soul.

selections.author: Maitreyee B Chowdhury
selections.title: Unfinished
selections.quote:
I begin and end with madness,
and like Poppy seeds fall asleep, deep-
without germination, water, or hope.
context: I begin and end with madness,
and like Poppy seeds fall asleep, deep-

selections.author: May Manoj
selections.title: Heaven on Earth
selections.quote:
You make everyday count;
Every moment without discount
Because you know life`s precious,
Everything`s auspicious.

selections.author: Rakesh Chandra
selections.title: Beyond the Olive Branches
selections.quote:
Involved,  by holding each-other`s hands,
In the unbreakable bonds of love.
context: One fine morning I realized that the peace
Can only be achieved by the people
In the unbreakable bonds of love.

selections.author: Shakuntala Gupta/ ଶକୁନ୍ତଳା ଗୁପ୍ତା
selections.title: ମୋ ଭିତରେ ଗାଆଁଟିଏ
selections.quote:
ତୁ ଭାଙ୍ଗିଦେଇ ପାରିବୁ, ଯାହା ଦୂରେଇ ଦିଏ

context: ତୁ ଭାଙ୍ଗିଦେଇ ପାରିବୁ, ଯାହା ଦୂରେଇ ଦିଏ

selections.author: Pusparani Patel/ ପୁଷ୍ପରାଣୀ ପଟେଲ
selections.title: କଵି ଓ କବିତା
selections.quote:
କବି ତୁମେ,କରିପାର ବର୍ଷା
ବିନା ସେଇ ଆଷାଢ ମେଘରେ
ତିନ୍ତାଇପାର ପ୍ରେମର ଫଲଗୁରେ
ତତଲା ବାଲିର ମରୁଭୂମି ପାଦ ସେକୁଥିବାବେଳେ ।

selections.author: Mridula Menon
selections.title: LOST IN THE SHIMMERING GLOW OF DREAMS
selections.quote:
Not as dreams ephemeral in nature
But in deeds
That pave the way for enriching our lives.
context: She was always fascinated by dreams
On the splendid wings of her dreams
As she became more mature in her thoughts
to realise how very childish she had been
in her school girl crush for dreams
True dreams give zest to life
If no effort we do make
Not to squander it in the shimmering halo
To take root in our minds
Not as dreams ephemeral in nature
That pave the way for enriching our lives.

selections.author: Julie Miles
selections.title: AUGUST FOR JAMIE
selections.quote:
It`s raining memories and
twenty four is written all over my arms.
Love does not fade It is not weathered nor seasonal.
context: The passing of time cannot subtract the bond
we shared from beginning to what seems to be the end.
They weep for you and feel your spirit each day
twenty four is written all over my arms.
Love does not fade It is not weathered nor seasonal.
Must we pour spice on anniversaries of everything?
must we lather these days and months
with suds and foamy words that do not reach
the root of the soil or the blood of the heart.
My sweet bird in the heavenly clouds
who was an original everything and mine!
We are reaching for you with the fingertips
in our minds pores and essence.
Tear ducts make a river leading to the you

selections.author: Punyadeepa Khamari / पुण्यदीपा खमारी
selections.title: आस
selections.quote:
बारिश तुम्हें बेहद पसंद है, मान लिया।
क्या कभी सोचा है,
पानी झरती कैसे है?
context: बारिश तुम्हें बेहद पसंद है, मान लिया।

selections.author: Shankar Chhatria / ଶଙ୍କର ଚ୍ଛତ୍ରିଆ
selections.title: ସୁଦୀର୍ଘ ପାଚେରୀ
selections.quote:
ଏତେ ତା`ର ଉତ୍କଣ୍ଠା ଓ ଆଗ୍ରହ
ବର୍ତ୍ତମାନ ଠାରୁ ଅତୀତକୁ ଫେରି ଯିବାର
ସ୍ମୃତି ଆଉ ସ୍ଵପ୍ନକୁ ଆଚ୍ଛନ୍ନ କରିବାର ।

selections.author: Neha Bhandarkar
selections.title: WORTHY MEETING
selections.quote:
I`ll beg you a thousand times
throughout all the seasons
to accept all of my
incomparable emotions.
context: I`ll beg you a thousand times

selections.author: Raja Chakraborty
selections.title: Crack
selections.quote:
this crack
on the wall
thin line to begin with
searching for expanse

selections.author: Afruja Akhtar
selections.title: Love in quest
selections.quote:
Seductive clouds draw near
Dark wings unfold, whispers clear
context: In your arms, my hands entwine
Tangled locks bind me to thee
selections.rationale: Selected for a coherent poetic image or central turn; wording preserved verbatim.

selections.author: Binati Satapathy/ ବିନତି ଶତପଥି
selections.title: ଶବ୍ଦଭୁକ
selections.quote:
ସବୁ ସାଇତି ଦେଇଛି ତମପାଇଁ
ଆସ, ଶବ୍ଦ ମାଗନାହିଁ !

selections.author: Ketaki Mazumdar
selections.title: Holding On Letting Go
selections.quote:
Mundane thoughts flow with the profound...
endless summers of flowers and hurricanes of destinies.
context: Mundane thoughts flow with the profound...
endless summers of flowers and hurricanes of destinies.

selections.author: Swapna Mishra/ ସ୍ଵପ୍ନା ମିଶ୍ର
selections.title: ମୁହୂର୍ତ୍ତରୁ
selections.quote:
ଏବେ ଏଇ ମୁହୂର୍ତ୍ତରୁ ମୁଁ ଭାବୁଛି ରାତିକୁ ଭିନ୍ନ ଅର୍ଥ ଦେବି
ସୁରାସାକିରୁ ଅଲଗା କରି
ମୋ ପ୍ରେମୀ ସହ ମିଳନକୁ ରାତି କହିବି।
context: ଏବେ ଏଇ ମୁହୂର୍ତ୍ତରୁ ମୁଁ ଭାବୁଛି ରାତିକୁ ଭିନ୍ନ ଅର୍ଥ ଦେବି
ମୋ ପ୍ରେମୀ ସହ ମିଳନକୁ ରାତି କହିବି।

selections.author: Devika Tripathy
selections.title: Where Love Lingers
selections.quote:
In the hush between heartbeats, where breath becomes memory,
Love`s lingering shadows drift like smoke..
context: In the hush between heartbeats, where breath becomes memory,
Love`s lingering shadows drift like smoke..
the way light moves through old glass..
The hurts unspoken do not vanish;
they nest in the quiet spaces beneath the ribs,
where the soul, torn but enduring,
learned to carry the weight of silence.
Music rises, not to fill the silence,
that circles back long after the voice is gone.
There are no grand declarations here,
only the whispers of small stories
a glance that lingered too long,
They are stitched together by time,
by a sorrow that has grown wise,
still stands quietly in the dark-

selections.author: Madhu Jaiswal
selections.title: Damsel
selections.quote:
Dreaming of being the entrepreneur of the year
She gulps a glass of water and carries on...
context: Her colleagues often compliment her as boss
Thinking she must be ruling similarly at home
Smiling with rye she just keeps mum
In her homely domain, she barely had her say
As and when she is back home
she needs to finish all the homely chores
She juggles hard to cook for all
Hardly have the energy to carry on!
How she wishes to have a helping hand
when asking for help she is advised
If can`t manage just sit at home
Dreaming of being the entrepreneur of the year
She gulps a glass of water and carries on...

selections.author: Manoj Chola
selections.title: Crawling Desert
selections.quote:
When the thorny edges
pierce in to my heart
all the emotions of humanity
drains away.

selections.title: पत्थर पिघल भी सकता था

selections.author: Amanita Sen
selections.title: To my son
selections.quote:
As I look back,
I see the years went by
when you were simply the breathe I inhaled a little further away from my body.
context: I see the years went by
when you were simply the breathe I inhaled a little further away from my body.
As easy, as unobtrusive like the air flowing in the lung, as inherently imperative for my soul.

selections.author: Gopikrishnan Kottoor
selections.title: The field is green
selections.quote: The early sun probes the solitary leaf with a kiss
context: I did not ask for, waiting,
Playing for a new birth in the wind.
It must all be, because of the night rains.
The early sun probes the solitary leaf with a kiss
Such that it turns almost fluid with the see- through colour of love that is happy
such that their beauty has lost all respect,
Strange things happen here in the field.
What is this Karma of small,
secret lives in hiding that glitter and wave,
or lie in camouflage all around,
wet with desires of the flesh,
that`s much more than butterfly iridescence or wasp sting, yet
its quiet hymns that hum on,
that seem without purpose or meaning, yet, is creation on Spark.
Ferral, sublime, with continued hurt that continuously go living and dying,
shaping the breath of our very lives!
all that we fathom are just the colours of the flowers in the wind in blossom,
the tip of the iceberg of beauty in passing.
But what makes the living and the dead,
together pulse this moment into the secret hull of life?

selections.author: Gayatri Das
selections.title: Song of Stone
selections.quote:
The ocean melts inside the mirror,
The red fish backstrokes in the sea.
context: The tidal moonlit night is dancing
in the eyes of the white swan,
The ocean melts inside the mirror,

selections.author: Mrutyunjay Sarangi

context: The curious onlookers came in hordes,

selections.author: M.Rudra
selections.title: UNSHACKLED DREAMS
selections.quote:
They are horrified to witness the dark, unmasking itself,
Shedding the blood of terror, the suspensive silence dwells.
context: Chains on my legs, kept shackled for centuries.
But agony and restlessness find their way to me,
The moonless night and sun set in, with misery.
They are horrified to witness the dark, unmasking itself,
Shedding the blood of terror, the suspensive silence dwells.
Disposition is always in doubt, the society scorns and mocks at me, leaving no way to rebel.
The epic fateful war of Mahabharata was fought to uphold my morality and respect,
But today only the lighten candles, handcuffed hands rise for me, even though in thousands in number fail to reflect.
The only thing that comes up in many minds,
If I were a boy, free from chains and despair,
At liberty to dream, rise and repair.

selections.author: Sankha Ranjan Patra
selections.title: Let It Happen
selections.quote:
Useless all without you
Earth, Heaven and Life ,
I care none ,I desire none
context: To blow up and to grow up again,
Must have spread in space again,
Maybe you may come back again

selections.author: Abeera Mirza
selections.title: THE WATERFALL
selections.quote:
Like this waterfall my dream will keep flowing in my veins,
I won`t stop until the day comes that I achieve my dream.
context: They say water symbolizes the flow of life,
But for me, this form of water symbolizes my dream;
Like this waterfall my dream will keep flowing in my veins,
I won`t stop until the day comes that I achieve my dream.

selections.author: Johny Takkedasila
selections.title: Sometimes I Freeze
selections.quote:

You,

context: Who are the cause of motion in me—

selections.quote:

Sometimes, it means I think.
context: Sometimes, it means I put a lot of thought
And then it shows too much
I want to balance how much I show
With how much I do not
And sometimes it doesn`t come out well
It is not about the writer`s worth.

selections.author: Satyananda Sarangi
selections.title: The Awakened Verse
selections.quote:
But when I came out of their sadness and delight
To live and love my own pain, I learnt how to write.
context: I didn`t write from childhood days but loved poetry;
For years, I felt it was the last thing I could do
Because whenever I tried, it lacked symmetry,
As if words had their minds to ensure I fell through.
I`d be cheered by daffodils, swept by the west wind,
Dreaming to leave my footprints on the sands of time;
The thoughts of Lord Ullin`s daughter would cross my mind
And make me visit an ancient mariner`s rhyme.
But when I came out of their sadness and delight
To live and love my own pain, I learnt how to write.
